This plot is small, only about a quarter hectare, but it is mine and it feeds my family, so I put my best effort here. I got a FISP coupon this year like many of my neighbors in Dedza, so I will buy one bag of NPK and one bag of urea at the subsidy price — without that, I could not afford both. I plant hybrid seed because the agro-dealer sold it together with the coupon, and I intercrop with beans like I did last season. I cannot afford to hire much labor for such a small plot — my wife and I will do most of the work ourselves, and I will only call two or three people for weeding when the rains come heavy.
